description: Live Tesla vehicle data and commands from the terminal via the Tessie API

tools.name: commands_send
tools.description: Send a vehicle command (honk, flash_lights, start_climate, etc.). Required: vin, command.

tools.name: vehicle_battery
tools.description: Get the current battery state of a vehicle: charge level percent, estimated driving range, and charging status. Required: vin.

tools.name: vehicle_location
tools.description: Get the vehicle geolocation metadata: latitude, longitude, street address, and any saved location associated with the car. Required: vin.

tools.name: vehicle_state
tools.description: Get the latest full state object of a vehicle: model, lock status, odometer, sentry mode, charge, and climate details. Required: vin. Optional: cache.

params.name: cache
params.description: Use cached state (legacy S/X only; default true)

tools.name: vehicle_wake
tools.description: Wake a sleeping vehicle so subsequent commands can reach it. Returns once the car is awake or after a timeout. Required: vin.

tools.name: vehicles_list
tools.description: List all vehicles with their latest state. Optional: active.
